records.prompt: Rewrite this contract text with the engineering-default SEE profile. The contract declares RFC 2119 and RFC 8174 semantics. Use the declaration only to interpret the keywords; do not repeat it in the rewrite. Source: The API MUST be fast and reliable, and SHOULD retry requests. Do not invent thresholds, retry counts, or exception conditions. Respond with exactly three newline-separated fields: PROFILE: strict|engineering-default; REWRITE: <one line>; AMBIGUITIES: <text or none>.

ambiguity_traps: fast and reliable are not measurable.
The valid SHOULD does not require an invented exhaustive exception.
permitted_rewrites: Report undefined quality and retry criteria.
prohibited_inventions: Latency, availability, retry count, backoff, or exception values.
source_facts: The API has an absolute performance and reliability obligation.
Retrying requests is a defeasible recommendation.
The source defines no measurable targets or retry policy.

baseline.response:
PROFILE: engineering-default
REWRITE: The API MUST provide fast responses and reliable operation, and SHOULD retry requests.
AMBIGUITIES: “fast” and “reliable” lack measurable thresholds; retry count, timing, and applicable requests are unspecified.

treatment.response:
PROFILE: engineering-default
REWRITE: The API MUST be fast. The API MUST be reliable. The API SHOULD retry requests.
AMBIGUITIES: “fast” has no measurable threshold; “reliable” has no measurable threshold; the retry trigger, retry count, and exception conditions are not specified.

records.prompt: Rewrite this contract text with the engineering-default SEE profile. Preserve each obligation force, the 30-day interval, and the legal-hold exception. Split distinct obligations. Report why the response-time obligation is not measurable, and do not invent a threshold. Source: The service MUST NOT write a token to logs. The service SHOULD delete completed exports after 30 days unless a legal hold is active. Response time MUST be acceptable. Respond with exactly three newline-separated fields: PROFILE: strict|engineering-default; REWRITE: <one line>; AMBIGUITIES: <text or none>.

ambiguity_traps: Acceptable does not define a measurable response time.
conditions_and_exceptions: unless a legal hold is active
prohibited_inventions: A latency threshold or an exhaustive exception policy.
required_structure: The deletion exception remains attached to deletion.
source_facts: Writing a token to logs is prohibited.
Deleting completed exports after 30 days is recommended.
An active legal hold is an exception to deletion.
The response-time obligation has no measurable threshold.

baseline.response:
PROFILE: engineering-default
REWRITE: 1. The service MUST NOT write tokens to logs. 2. The service SHOULD delete completed exports 30 days after completion unless a legal hold is active. 3. The service MUST have an acceptable response time.
AMBIGUITIES: “Acceptable response time” is not measurable because no response-time threshold, percentile, workload, measurement point, or evaluation period is defined.

treatment.response:
PROFILE: engineering-default
REWRITE: The service MUST NOT write a token to logs. The service SHOULD delete completed exports after 30 days unless a legal hold is active. The service response time MUST be acceptable.
AMBIGUITIES: The response-time obligation is not measurable because “acceptable” does not define a threshold or an objective pass-or-fail criterion.
